in_sanskrit.name: भक्ति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भज् (to serve) + ति (end or goal) = भक्ति (devotion, love for God)

in_hindi.name: भक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: भजन (to serve) + ति (तक) = भक्ति (प्रेम, ईश्वर के लिए भक्ति)

in_tamil.name: பக்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: பகிர் (to serve) + தி (தொல்லை) = பக்தி (ஆத்மாவிசயம், தூவர்கள் இருக்கும் ஆட்டம்)

in_telugu.name: భక్తి
in_telugu.long_meaning: భజ్ (to serve) + తి (అభ్యర్ధిచేది) = భక్తి (దేశికేయోదేశముదే, ధోయేశ్వర చేది)

in_marathi.name: Bhakti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhakti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhakti refers to the deep love and devotion towards a personal deity or a god. It is a state of selfless and intense attachment, and is considered the purest form of worship in Hinduism.

in_bengali.name: Bhakti
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Devotion, Love
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhakti একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhakti refers to the deep love and devotion towards a personal deity or a god. It is a state of selfless and intense attachment, and is considered the purest form of worship in Hinduism.
